author: vvo
subject: v3.0.0
bodyLines: * **Configure:** add configure parameters in search state (algolia/react-instantsearch#1935) ([f552d08](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/f552d08)), closes [#1863](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/1863)
* **Hits:** limit the hitComponent to be only a function (algolia/react-instantsearch#1912) ([3ec2093](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/3ec2093))

* **Pagination:** fix and indicate when pagination is disabled ([4e2036c](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/4e2036c)), closes [algolia/react-instantsearch#1938](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/1938)
* **withSearchBox:** keep displaying searchBox when no items found (algolia/react-instantsearch#1930) ([47a0107](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/47a0107))
* **MultiRange:** indicate if a range has no refinements (algolia/react-instantsearch#1926) ([ba873fe](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/ba873fe))
* **starRating:** indicate when any refinement has no effect ([6926fc8](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/6926fc8))
